items.title: Denmark to expel Russia’s military attaché after arrests in alleged plot to kill Ukrainian rapper
items.summary: Denmark will expel Russia’s military attaché, who must leave the country within seven days, Danish Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen announced at a press conference. Danish security services believe Russian security services hired the suspects to kill the rapper.
